verdict.line: You lose if you burn Counter Strike early and eat her E-into-auto burst; you win if you hold E for her all-in and punish her Q once it stops resetting.

brief.thesis: Irelia's damage is gated behind landing E (Flawless Duet) — the stun is what lets her get free autos, refresh Q (Bladesurge) off a mark, or safely charge W (Defiant Dance). Jax's E (Counter Strike) dodges every basic attack she throws out and stuns her back, which is the direct counter to her committing without a stun of her own up. That's why Jax carries a real head-to-head edge (51.1% over 1389 games) even though the overall shape is even — he has the built-in answer to her win condition.

theirWindow.what: You're stunned and marked — she'll follow with autos, a Q (Bladesurge) reset off the mark, or start charging W. Expect burst in the next second and don't fight through it.

yourWindow.what: Walk up and threaten the trade or all-in. She has no stun to protect a charging W or set up a Q reset, so your E (Counter Strike) dodges her autos and stuns her back with nothing to answer it.

powerCurve.note: Her early Q poke pressures trades

start.why: 51.5% win rate over 1355 games and by far the most picked start (76.4%) — the AD and lifesteal win the auto-attack trades this lane is built around.

boots.why: 51.4% win rate over 1322 games and the standard pick (78.6%) — it blunts the auto-attacks that feed her passive (Ionian Fervor) stacks.

core.why: The Trinity Force > Sundered Sky > Zhonya's Hourglass path is the top build (54.2% win rate, 214 games) and is your single biggest damage/tempo spike.
Continues the on-hit and healing power that lets you win extended trades and all-ins.
Lets you engage or survive dives without being deleted once teamfights start.

situational.when: she or her team is outscaling you and you need to survive extended fights (53% win rate over 83 games with this swap)
you need earlier dueling power and kiting against a tankier lineup (51.5% win rate over 68 games with this path)
her team's CC or burst is what's ending your trades rather than her raw damage (49.2% win rate over 248 games)

runes.keystoneWhy: 51.1% win rate at 45.7% pick — the attack speed ramp stacks with Empower (W) and Relentless Assault (R) to win the same extended trades and all-ins your Counter Strike (E) sets up.

summoners.why: Flash + Ignite is the standard pick (77.7%, 50.6% win rate) and converts your solo-kill advantage into real kills by cutting through her Q (Bladesurge) heal. Exhaust + Flash (53.5% win rate, 13.1% pick) is the safer alternative if you'd rather neutralize her all-in than kill through it.

playing.title: Hold E for her stun
playing.detail: Don't burn Counter Strike (E) to poke or peel minions. Save it for the moment she commits E (Flawless Duet) and closes in — it dodges her follow-up autos and stuns her back when her own CC is down.

playing.title: Trade after she Qs a minion
playing.detail: Bladesurge (Q) only resets off a marked or killed champion, so if she dashes onto a minion it's now on a real cooldown (10/9/8/7/6s). That's your window to hit Leap Strike (Q) plus Empower (W).

playing.title: Don't feed a charging W
playing.detail: While she charges Defiant Dance (W) she takes reduced physical damage. Walk out of range or wait rather than dumping autos or an Empowered hit into the charge.

playing.title: All-in on your level 6
playing.detail: Pop Relentless Assault (R) before you engage so attack speed is already climbing, land Empower (W) on the first hit, and keep Counter Strike (E) in reserve for her stun.

playing.title: Punish a missing E specifically
playing.detail: If Flawless Duet (E) is down, walk up and threaten the fight. She has no stun to protect a charge-up W or set up a Q reset, so your Counter Strike wins any extended trade.

playing.title: Rush Trinity Force
playing.detail: The Trinity Force > Sundered Sky > Zhonya's path (54.2% win rate) is your real power spike. Look to force skirmishes right as Trinity completes.

playing.title: Ignite the all-in, not the poke
playing.detail: Save Ignite for when you're actually committing to a kill — it removes the Q (Bladesurge) sustain she leans on to survive extended trades.

brief.patchCaveat: Build order, win rates, and sample sizes are pulled directly from measured OP.GG games on the current patch (16.19.1); the cooldown windows and trade-pattern reasoning are our own tactical read, not measured data.

stats.opponentTip: Use Counter Strike [E] when Irelia closes in after landing her Flawless Duet (E) to block her follow up damage. You will have the upper hand if you manage to hit her with Counter Strike [E] when Flawless Duet (E) is on cooldown.
